name: Thronefall
short_description: A minimalist kingdom builder: build by day, defend by night as a mounted king.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: A minimalist kingdom builder: build by day, defend by night as a mounted king.

identity.core_loop: Day: spend coins on buildings. Night: ride out and fight beside your towers. Morning: collect and grow.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Gentle, crisp, short; the day and night swap is the heartbeat.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: Coins drop and float in the world; build spots glow on the ground; night light tells you danger is coming. Tiny HUD.

identity.audio_mood: Calm day music, drums at night.
identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: Day and night as the one signal that changes light, music and play. Very close to the Ranch's rhythm.
